crossRefs.note: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”
translations.bsb: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
translations.kjv: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
translations.asv: The Jews therefore said unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
